snippet.title: Ramen Haven – Official Gameplay Trailer| Cozy Ramen Cooking Game
snippet.description:
Welcome to Ramen Haven, a cozy cooking and management game where you run your own ramen cart! 🍜

Prepare delicious bowls of ramen, manage customer orders, improve your reputation, and create a welcoming experience for every customer.

The free demo is available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5101750/Ramen_Haven/

Play the demo, add Ramen Haven to your wishlist, and share your feedback with us as we continue developing the game.

Developed and published by Lambda GameWorks.

Follow us for future updates, gameplay videos, and announcements!

#RamenHaven #CozyGames #IndieGames
